steps.reason: Compare health under reference prices and estimate observed liquidation cost; gate compensation on evidence.
steps.plannerRationaleUnverified: Replay shows liquidation succeeded only at spot/higher prices (2915–2918 µUSDC/WETH), reverted at 30-min TWAP (2914 µUSDC/WETH), and would have succeeded at 5-min TWAP (2914 µUSDC/WETH). Health factor crossed liquidation threshold only with spot price. No oracle fault proven; price sensitivity reproduced but causality to compensation unestablished.

observation.reason: The saved historical execution reproduces mainnet gas and all 25 logs. Replaying with either independently observed Uniswap spot price still liquidates the borrower. Some lagging TWAP scenarios prevent liquidation, but this does not establish oracle failure. Oracle-caused damage and compensation entitlement are not proven.
observation.lossDefinition: Collateral transferred to the liquidator plus receipt-verified aToken transfers to the reserve treasury, valued in USDC, minus WETH debt discharged at each reference price.
